from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,stat
p=Path('/home/arduino/sumox26-capture-tools/app-default-beeffff315b2e28a95a20dc1e26477fc924b2da26d1fdd8a8b36fb013ca110e1')
pins={'app_default_capture.py': 'beeffff315b2e28a95a20dc1e26477fc924b2da26d1fdd8a8b36fb013ca110e1', 'p0_capture.py': '885c4e4206aea4ac9e03c4e92e48258db2a0ae302ff83a86430e6913afeeb57c', 'recorder_heap.py': 'd661024975925a7d8a83f4b772199bbf59911adb5adb8ea69a2082b69eed4b92', 'p0_mem_read.cfg': '89d16a28a1489c23ec743be55ade39824f9ca5213b02b20ef4785079122e4339'}
assert sorted(a.name for a in p.iterdir())==sorted(pins)
actual={}
for name,expected in pins.items():
    q=p/name; assert not q.is_symlink() and stat.S_ISREG(q.stat().st_mode)
    value=hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); assert value==expected
    actual[name]=value
print(json.dumps(actual))
